تنتصبون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَصِبُونَ (tantaṣibūna) /tan.ta.sˤi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# تُنْتَصَبُونَ (tuntaṣabūna) /tun.ta.sˤa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
